name: noxinfluencer
description_zh: 通过自然语言发现和分析红人、管理营销计划与合作、监测内容并导出业务数据。支持通过已连接的 MCP 或独立 CLI 执行。
description_en: Discover and evaluate creators, manage campaigns and partnerships, monitor content, and export results through a connected MCP provider or the isolated NoxInfluencer CLI.
author: NoxInfluencer
examples_zh: 找一批适合美国户外品牌的 YouTube 红人
查看这个营销计划的候选达人和合作进度
查看这次营销活动已监测的视频和表现
examples_en: Find US YouTube creators for an outdoor brand
Show the selected creators and partnership progress for this campaign
Show the tracked videos and performance for this campaign
